units.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
units.label: Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 1. A deputy of the City Duma interacts with state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast and local self-government bodies located within the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: A deputy of the City Duma has the right to visit local self-government bodies and municipal enterprises and institutions without hindrance when resolving matters within the competence of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 31 · “A deputy of the City Duma has the right to visit local…”

units.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: On matters concerning their activities as a deputy, a deputy of the City Duma enjoys the right to be received without waiting in turn by the heads and officials of local self-government bodies and municipal enterprises and institutions.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 31 · “On matters concerning their activities as a deputy, a deputy of…”

units.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 2. A deputy of the City Duma has the right of rule-making initiative in accordance with this Charter.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 3. A deputy of the City Duma has the right to express their opinion and has the right to vote on all matters considered by the City Duma and by any commission of which the deputy is a member.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: A deputy of the City Duma participates personally in meetings of the City Duma and its commissions.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 31 · “A deputy of the City Duma participates personally in meetings…”

units.locator: Article 31. Basic rights of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: A deputy of the City Duma exercises the rights granted to them at meetings of the City Duma and its commissions in accordance with the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 31 · “A deputy of the City Duma exercises the rights granted to them…”

units.locator: Article 32. Deputy’s interpellation
units.text: Article 32. Deputy’s interpellation
units.label: Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Deputy’s interpellation
units.text: A deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies may address a deputy’s interpellation to the Head of Yekaterinburg, officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, representatives of oblast executive authorities within the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, and heads of state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Art. 32 · “A deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies may address a…”

units.locator: Article 32. Deputy’s interpellation
units.text: The decision to recognize a deputy’s submission as a deputy’s interpellation is adopted by the City Duma.
units.label: Art. 32 · “The decision to recognize a deputy’s submission as a deputy’s…”

units.locator: Article 32. Deputy’s interpellation
units.text: The Head of Yekaterinburg and officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg to whom a deputy’s interpellation is addressed must reply to it in writing no later than 25 days after its receipt.
units.label: Art. 32 · “The Head of Yekaterinburg and officials of the Administration…”

units.locator: Article 33. Submission by a deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies
units.text: Article 33. Submission by a deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies
units.label: Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Submission by a deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies
units.text: A deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies of the City Duma may address a question or proposal to the Head of Yekaterinburg, officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, representatives of oblast executive authorities within the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, and heads of state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Art. 33 · “A deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies of the City…”

units.locator: Article 33. Submission by a deputy of the City Duma or a group of deputies
units.text: The deputy or group of deputies delivers the submission in writing to the Chair of the City Duma; this constitutes grounds for inviting its addressees or their representatives to a meeting of the City Duma in accordance with its Rules of Procedure.
units.label: Art. 33 · “The deputy or group of deputies delivers the submission in…”

units.locator: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. The Head of Yekaterinburg is the highest official of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, vested with their own powers to resolve matters of local significance. The Head of Yekaterinburg has powers to exercise specific state powers transferred by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. The Head of Yekaterinburg is elected by the City Duma for a term of five years from among candidates presented by the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast and heads the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. The powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg commence on the day of election by the City Duma and ceremonial assumption of office and cease on the day the City Duma of the new convocation holds the meeting at which the election of the Head of Yekaterinburg is considered.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: The ceremonial assumption of office by the Head of Yekaterinburg includes taking the following oath: “I, (surname, first name, patronymic), upon assuming office as Head of Yekaterinburg, solemnly swear to observe the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws, the Charter and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, and the Charter of the Urban Okrug Municipality ‘City of Yekaterinburg’, to exercise honestly and conscientiously the powers granted to me and perform the duties entrusted to me, and to serve faithfully the prosperity of the Municipality ‘City of Yekaterinburg’ and the well-being of its residents”.”.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 34 · “The ceremonial assumption of office by the Head of…”

units.locator: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4. In their activities, the Head of Yekaterinburg is subject to oversight by, and accountable to, the population of the municipality and the City Duma. The Head of Yekaterinburg exercises their powers on a full-time basis.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4-1. In accordance with the principle of unity of the system of public authority, the Head of Yekaterinburg simultaneously holds a state office of Sverdlovsk Oblast and a municipal office.
units.label: Point 4-1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5. The Head of Yekaterinburg must observe the restrictions and prohibitions and perform the duties established by Federal Law of 25 December 2008 No. 273-ФЗ ‘On Combating Corruption’, Federal Law of 3 December 2012 No. 230-ФЗ ‘On Monitoring the Compliance of Expenditures of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons with Their Income’, and Federal Law of 7 May 2013 No. 79-ФЗ ‘On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments’.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6. The Head of Yekaterinburg is exempt from liability for failure to observe the restrictions, prohibitions and requirements for preventing or resolving conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform the duties, established by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ and other federal laws for the purpose of combating corruption, if such non-compliance and failure to perform duties are recognized as resulting from circumstances beyond their control according to the procedure provided for in parts 3–6 of Article 13 of Federal Law of 25 December 2008 No. 273-ФЗ ‘On Combating Corruption’.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. The Head of Yekaterinburg, as the highest official of the municipality, is vested, in accordance with this Article of the Charter, with their own powers to resolve matters of local significance:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1) represents the municipality in relations with state authorities, local self-government bodies and officials, citizens and organizations irrespective of their form of ownership;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2) represents the interests of the population of the municipality in relations with local self-government bodies and officials;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3) is the official representative of the municipality within the country and abroad;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4) acts on behalf of the municipality without a power of attorney;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5) determines the directions for developing the municipality’s regional, interregional, international and foreign economic relations;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6) concludes contracts and agreements on behalf of the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 7) takes measures to ensure the protection of the municipality’s interests in courts and other state bodies;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 8) organizes and ensures the exercise by local self-government bodies of powers to resolve matters of local significance and of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 9) personally receives citizens;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 10) signs and promulgates, according to the procedure determined by this Charter, normative decisions adopted by the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 11) has the right to reject decisions adopted by the City Duma and returns such acts to the City Duma with a reasoned justification for their rejection or proposals for amendments and additions;
units.label: Subpoint 11 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 12) may require the convening of an extraordinary meeting of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 12 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 13) submits to the City Duma an annual report on the results of their own activities and those of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, including the resolution of matters raised by the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 13 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 14) issues resolutions and executive orders on matters assigned to their competence by this Charter in accordance with Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ and other federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint 14 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 15) ensures publication of the normative legal acts issued by them that affect human and civil rights, freedoms and duties;
units.label: Subpoint 15 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 16) designates the local self-government body authorized to exercise powers in the sphere of municipal-private partnership in accordance with Federal Law of 13 July 2015 No. 224-ФЗ ‘On Public-Private Partnership and Municipal-Private Partnership in the Russian Federation and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation’;
units.label: Subpoint 16 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 17) directs the development and implementation of measures for civil defence, the prevention and response to emergencies, and the elimination of the consequences of natural disasters within the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 17 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 18) participates in measures to prevent terrorism and to minimize and/or eliminate the consequences of its manifestations, organized by federal executive bodies and/or executive bodies of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Subpoint 18 Point 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. The Head of Yekaterinburg exercises the following powers of the head of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg:
units.label: Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1) directs the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg on the principle of sole authority;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2) issues resolutions of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg on matters of local significance and matters related to the exercise of specific state powers transferred to the municipality’s local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, as well as executive orders of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg on the organization of its work;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3) organizes the implementation of decisions of the City Duma within their competence;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4) organizes work to develop the draft budget (budget and medium-term financial plan) of the municipality and the draft strategy for its socio-economic development;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5) administers the revenue and expenditure estimate of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6) ensures and organizes the exercise by local self-government bodies of powers to resolve matters of local significance and of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 7) organizes the exercise of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 8) submits the draft strategy for the socio-economic development of the municipality to the City Duma for approval;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 9) submits the draft municipal budget and the report on its execution to the City Duma for approval;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 10) submits to the City Duma draft decisions, or gives opinions on draft decisions of the City Duma, providing for the establishment, introduction and termination of local taxes, the establishment of local tax benefits and the grounds and procedure for their application, and expenditure from the local budget;
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 11) submits to the City Duma draft decisions determining the procedure for managing and disposing of municipally owned property;
units.label: Subpoint 11 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 12) submits to the City Duma drafts of other decisions whose adoption falls within the competence of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 12 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 13) submits the structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg to the City Duma for approval and forms the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 13 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 14) adopts decisions on preparing the municipality’s draft master plan and draft land-use and development rules, as well as decisions on preparing proposals to amend the municipality’s master plan and land-use and development rules;
units.label: Subpoint 14 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 15) approves the composition and operating procedure of the commission for preparing the municipality’s draft land-use and development rules;
units.label: Subpoint 15 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 16) appoints and removes from their posts municipal servants holding municipal-service posts in the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and other employees of that Administration, unless otherwise provided for by municipal legal acts;
units.label: Subpoint 16 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 17) applies incentives and disciplinary measures to municipal servants holding municipal-service posts in the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and other employees of that Administration, unless otherwise provided for by municipal legal acts;
units.label: Subpoint 17 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 18) organizes the protection of public order within the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 18 Point 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 19) ensures primary fire-safety measures within the boundaries of the municipality and the activities of the municipal fire service;
units.label: Subpoint 19 Point 2 Art. 35
